affected_party: Organizations planning a portable QIF trust-policy change across an existing knowledge population
actual_problem: QIF can replay one historical decision but cannot prove that a proposed policy was evaluated against every in-scope portable knowledge item before activation.
why_it_matters: An unseen item, missing attestation, or changed outcome can become an unmeasured blast radius and surprise operators after enforcement.
why_now: v0.8.5 added immutable policy lineage and per-decision replay; population-level rollout preview is the next lifecycle boundary.
